label: Finding-104
title: scale-latvia: 1 smaller precision and sourcing point
description: Quoted 'potentially' is the site's translation, and 'public sector' renders 'valsts sektor_' (state sector): The note puts 'potentially' in quotation marks, but the capture is Latvian ('potenci_li'). Quoting a translation should be marked as a translation. 'valsts sektor_' is 'state sector'; 'public sector' is a fair gloss but not exact. numbers.json n-6000-lv also says this is 'the only one that says potentially', yet NCSC-NL's inventory title says 'potentially affected' too.
